notes.title: Improved Natsuki Chronicles, Version 1.0.1.2 has been released!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Natsuki Chronicles fans - Version 1.0.1.2 comes with a couple of improvements!
[/b]
Fixed the crash bugs that sometimes occurs when:
[i]- playing the game in a high frame rate environment.
- enemies are continuously hit with Special Weapons etc.[/i]
As a result of these fixes, the crash bug that mainly occurred during the Stage 5 Boss fight has been fixed.
